Aditi Rao: Heads-up — finalizing acceptance thresholds for the new 70B (int4) bring-up. Need a compact checklist for canary+full rollouts: pass/fail rules, sample sizes, and quick smoke tests. Any obvious misses?
Marco Li: Suggest splitting into 3 acceptance buckets: functional (prompt-suite pass rate), regression (statistical delta vs baseline), perf (latency / p95 and cost/unit). Each bucket gets metric + hard threshold + advisory thresholds.
Jin Park: +1. For regression we should use bootstrap CI on the eval harness. Require p>=0.95 that mean_score >= baseline_mean for a pass. Sample size target: 2k per slice where possible.
Sasha Moreno: Also include perturbation/robustness tests: typos, truncation, persona prompts. Add a small adversarial subset (200 examples) that must not degrade by >5% exact-match. Hallucination checks on knowledge prompts too.
eval-bot: ```harness v2.4 run summary
run_id: run_2026_03_17_82
baseline_mean: 0.743
candidate_mean: 0.721
delta: -0.022
bootstrap_p(candidate>=baseline): 0.12
notes: regression detected; failing at current thresholds
```
Marco Li: p=0.12 -> fail on regression. But check slice-level diffs; one slice with heavy format changes can drag aggregate down. Do we treat high-impact slices as blockers?
Sasha Moreno: We should. Define priority slices: customer-critical intents, safety/abuse, billing/monetization flows. Any regression there is auto-block.
Aditi Rao: Agreed. Operational rollback: for hosted we auto-fallback to the previous fp16 variant for 5% of traffic on canary fail; manual hold for 100% deploys. Prioritization: routes serving production customers and high-throughput endpoints first.
Jin Park: Quick local eval CLI for reproducing harness run:
```bash
redwood-eval run --model candidate-70b-int4 --suite core_prompts.json --bootstrap 1000 --output ./artifacts/run_$(date +%s).json
```
Use that to reproduce the numbers in CI.
ops-bot: Reminder: upload artifacts and logs to s3://redwood-evals/artifacts/ and tag with run_id + model + git_sha. Default retention for canary artifacts = 90 days.
Aditi Rao: Action items:
- Marco: codify thresholds for the three buckets in the onboarding spreadsheet and mark mandatory slices (due EOD Wed)
- Jin: add bootstrap p-value check to the harness and a quick `--smoke` mode that runs ~500 examples (due PR by Fri)
- Sasha: assemble perturbation + hallucination subset (200 adv + 200 halluc checks) and wire it into canary suite
- Ops: confirm artifact retention and a simple run metadata schema (run_id, model, quant_config, env, git_sha)
We'll sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to sign off.
Marco Li: Will add a "must-pass" hardlist for safety / NLU safety examples. If any of those fail -> immediate hold.
Jin Park: I'll include an example reproducible notebook and a curl snippet in the PR so ENG can run locally.
Sasha Moreno: :thumbsup: Thanks all — this checklist looks actionable.
